about-us.title: About the member account
about-us.subtitle: PafPaf is the platform clubs, salons and associations use to manage their members. This is its member side.
about-us.introText: Each club on PafPaf manages its own members. Your account connects you to your clubs: you register once and join as many clubs as you need.
about-us.detailsText: Find the club in the catalogue or open the link the club gave you, fill in its form and send it. Your documents and signature are passed to the club automatically.
about-us.principleOneTitle: Your data goes only to your clubs
about-us.principleOneText: A club receives your data when you join it. Other clubs on the platform do not see it.
about-us.principleTwoText: No need to register again for each club: the same login works everywhere.
about-us.principleThreeText: Membership terms, opening hours and house rules are set by each club. Ask your club if you have questions about them.
about-us.valuesTitle: What you can do in your account
about-us.valueOne: Show your personal QR code at the club entrance
about-us.valueTwo: See your clubs and membership number
about-us.valueFour: Review your spending in each club
about-us.valueSix: Choose the interface language: Spanish, English or Russian
about-us.footer: For questions about membership, visits or club rules, contact your club directly.
